containers.name: build
command: apt-get update -qq; apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends musl-tools curl ca-certificates; mkdir /src; curl -fLsS https://github.com/sealant-sh/sealantd/archive/5173e4920d44d5663b6a4fec4606ab58e7607ca1.tar.gz | tar xz -C /src --strip-components=1; cd /src; rustup target add aarch64-unknown-linux-musl; cargo build --locked --release --bin sealantctl --target aarch64-unknown-linux-musl; target/aarch64-unknown-linux-musl/release/sealantctl --help; target/aarch64-unknown-linux-musl/release/sealantctl capture flush --help; touch /build-complete; sleep 1800
